body.x: CodeIdea (CEO Young-chan Lee, Dong-Wook Lee) participated in the ‘Future Innovation Tech Expo 2024 (FIX 2024)’ held from October 23 to 26 at Daegu EXCO.

CodeIdea is dedicated to nurturing future talents by developing and disseminating software education content. The company offers tailored programs covering web and app development, game programming, and artificial intelligence (AI) for middle schools, high schools, universities, and other institutions.

The company also organizes software-integrated education events and competitions, providing opportunities for participants to gain hands-on project experience. Events such as autonomous mobility competitions, AI Hackathons and Ideathons, and algorithm contests promote teamwork, creativity, and problem-solving skills among students, earning widespread recognition for their effectiveness.

At this exhibition, CodeIdea introduced its customized software education programs. These programs are designed to align with students’ levels and goals in various fields, balancing theoretical learning with practical application. The curriculum equips learners with technical skills applicable to real-world projects.

The programs emphasize creative problem-solving and practical coding skills, reflecting the latest software trends. The company highlighted its commitment to enhancing creativity and industry-ready skills through innovative educational approaches.

In addition to its education programs, CodeIdea showcased its interactive education platform, “Smart Station,” which supports immersive experiences with the latest AI technologies. This platform and its software-integrated education events aim to foster a hands-on understanding of cutting-edge fields such as autonomous driving, AI, and IoT.

body.cap: CodeIdea booth at FIX 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A representative from CodeIdea stated, “We are here to introduce our diverse range of educational and ICT experience programs. We aim to create collaboration opportunities with more educational institutions and companies. Through interactive programs focused on core technologies of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, such as AI and IoT, we aim to solidify our position as a leader in education innovation.”

They added, “Our goal is to collaborate on global education programs to nurture future talents with international competitiveness. We hope to provide broader learning experiences and expand our reach. We ask for your support as we continue to innovate and grow.”

FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
